# IA Code Studio — Complete Technical Reference (llms-full.txt)

Canonical URL: https://ia-codestudio.com/
French Portal: https://ia-codestudio.com/fr/
Sitemap: https://ia-codestudio.com/sitemap.xml
Languages Supported: English (EN) and French (FR)
Pricing Model: Freemium — $0 Free Starter (full live preview, 10+ offline dev tools, 1 starter app ZIP export/day, live demos & showcase) | $10/month Pro Creator (unlimited HTML/CSS/JS/ZIP/React/Vue/GLB/3MF exports across all studios via Stripe).
Architecture: 100% browser-based Vanilla HTML5, CSS3, ES6+ JavaScript, Monaco & CodeMirror editors, Three.js WebGL, client-side JSZip, Firebase Auth/Firestore, Netlify CDN & Serverless Functions.

---

## 1. Flagship AI Web IDE Workspaces

### IA Architecte Studio Pro
- Live App: https://ia-codestudio.com/ia-architecte-app/
- Feature Overview: https://ia-codestudio.com/ia-architecte-studio-pro/
- Purpose: Flagship browser AI IDE for generating, editing, auditing, and exporting standalone HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Three.js web applications from plain English or French prompts.
- Capabilities: Monaco Code Editor, Prompt-to-App generation, Live split-screen 60 FPS preview, API design, SaaS templates, cybersecurity & accessibility auditing, Tailwind transpilation, 1-click standalone HTML & modular ZIP export.
- Deep-Link Prompt Launch: Supports `https://ia-codestudio.com/ia-architecte-app/?prompt=YOUR_PROMPT&lang=en` (or `lang=fr`) to auto-fill and execute an AI prompt on launch.

### IA Architecte Studio Ultra v2.0
- Live App: https://ia-codestudio.com/ia-architecte-studio-ultra/
- Purpose: Companion multi-screen AI workbench featuring 28+ functional app templates, visual CSS style editor, local database engine, 3D/AR spatial previews, and DevOps packager (Dockerfile, docker-compose, nginx.conf, Cloudflare Worker).

---

## 2. 3D & WebGL Visual Studios Hub (https://ia-codestudio.com/3d-studios/)

1. **3D Creative Studio v2.0** (`https://ia-codestudio.com/3d-creative-studio/`): 72+ customizable 3D web UI components across 20 categories (3D buttons, holographic cards, 3D globes, Bento grids, interactive menus, Web Audio synths) with HTML, React JSX, Vue 3 SFC, and Web Component exports.
2. **3D Liquid Chrome & Neon Studio** (`https://ia-codestudio.com/3d-liquid-chrome-studio/`): 18 procedural 4D WebGL compartments (Cyber-Mecha 4D, Haute Horlogerie Tourbillon, Hypercar, Stargate Portal, Alien Mothership, Living Fractals, Metaballs) with real-time liquid chrome reflection shaders, audio reactivity, and 3MF multicolor 3D-print / GLB / standalone HTML exports. Guide: `https://ia-codestudio.com/3d-liquid-chrome-generator.html`.
3. **Studio 3D/4D Pro** (`https://ia-codestudio.com/studio-3d-4d-pro/`): 2D vector extruder (SVG & DXF to volumetric 3D Three.js meshes), 3D model importer (STL, GLB, OBJ), procedural generators, and standalone HTML/ZIP compiler.
4. **HyperStudio 3D/4D Engine** (`https://ia-codestudio.com/hyperstudio-3d-4d/`): Real-time 3D/4D HTML code engine, PBR environments, 4D morphing, audio FFT visualizers, WebAR export, and cosmic space flight simulator.
5. **Quantum 3D HUD Builder** (`https://ia-codestudio.com/hologram-hud-builder/`): Interactive sci-fi holographic interface builder with GLSL Fresnel presets, reactor cores, tactical radars, and OBS/PNG/Video exports.
6. **Cyber Creative Studio** (`https://ia-codestudio.com/cyber-creative-studio/`): 3D cinematic video intro generator with talking AI robot hosts, 60 FPS video export, and darksynth beat maker.

---

## 3. Free Offline Developer Tools Hub (https://ia-codestudio.com/free-tools/)

All developer tools execute 100% locally in the browser with zero server uploads, zero tracking, and offline PWA support:
- **OmniConvert Pro 2.0** (`https://ia-codestudio.com/free-tools/omni-convert/`): JSON, XML, YAML, Base64, QR generator, hash/crypto & CSS gradient workstation.
- **Live HTML/CSS/JS Sandbox v2.0** (`https://ia-codestudio.com/free-tools/playground/`): Split-screen CodeMirror editor with integrated console, Three.js/Bento presets, and `#code=` link sharing.
- **CSS Mesh Gradient & Shadow Lab** (`https://ia-codestudio.com/free-tools/converters/css-mesh-lab/`): Multi-orb mesh gradients, smooth layered shadows, neon borders for CSS & Tailwind.
- **CSS Grid & Bento Layout Builder** (`https://ia-codestudio.com/free-tools/converters/grid-bento-builder/`): Visual responsive Bento Box CSS Grid generator.
- **Dev Swiss Kit Pro** (`https://ia-codestudio.com/free-tools/converters/dev-swiss-kit/`): Live Regex tester, offline JWT decoder, UUID & Web Crypto key generator.
- **Tailwind to Vanilla CSS Pro** (`https://ia-codestudio.com/free-tools/converters/tailwind-to-vanilla/`): Transpile Tailwind utility classes into clean CSS or inline email styles.
- **SVG Optimizer & JSX Extractor** (`https://ia-codestudio.com/free-tools/converters/svg-optimizer/`): Sanitize, minify, and convert SVGs into React JSX components.
- **3D Text Maker Pro** (`https://ia-codestudio.com/free-tools/converters/font-previewer-3d/`): Extruded WebGL PBR 3D typography studio.
- **Markdown GFM to HTML Pro** (`https://ia-codestudio.com/free-tools/converters/markdown-to-html/`): Live sanitized GitHub-Flavored Markdown compiler.
- **Base64 Toolkit Pro** (`https://ia-codestudio.com/free-tools/converters/base64/`): UTF-8, URL-Safe Base64, CSS `url()` & image preview.
- **Glassmorphic Card Studio** (`https://ia-codestudio.com/free-tools/converters/text-to-html/`): 3D tilt & WCAG contrast card generator.

## 8. Frequently Asked Questions
- **Is IA Code Studio free?** Yes, building and live previewing in IA Architecte Studio Pro, using all 10+ offline developer tools, downloading 1 starter ZIP/day, and testing 3D demos/showcase are 100% free. Pro ($10/month) unlocks unlimited source exports across all studios.
- **Do developer tools upload my code or files?** Never. OmniConvert Pro and all Free Tools execute strictly client-side in your browser.
- **What code formats can I export?** Clean standalone HTML, modular HTML/CSS/JS ZIP bundles, React JSX, Vue 3 SFC, Web Components, GLB, and multicolor 3MF.
